The system runs multiple Hermes Agent workers concurrently against a single local vLLM endpoint. The vLLM backend handles continuous batching, so parallel workers share one loaded model server. See `README.md:5-7` and the architecture diagram at `README.md:9-28`.

Use the model-agnostic compose file at `config/vllm/docker-compose.yml:1-26`. You must set required environment variables before bringing it up:

**Required:**
- `HCA_MODEL_PATH` — path or HuggingFace ID of the model
- `HCA_MODEL_NAME` — served model name visible in `/v1/models`

- `HCA_VLLM_IMAGE` (default: `vllm/vllm-openai:latest`)
